rv.q: Their performances pull out all the stops.
This play is perfect for those interested in intimate stories with small casts that touch on socio-political topics in nuanced and complex ways.
All in all, this intimate and forceful presentation is a must see!

cn.t: Critics praise this powerful two-hander for its meaningful exploration of a couple's unraveling relationship as past revelations surface, though it starts deceptively light before delving into deeper, thought-provoking territory.
